snippet.title: Void Scout | Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Void Scout now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226540/Void_Scout/

Save reality one mission at a time! A seemingly unimportant Void Scout gets thrown into the middle of an interdimensional war, as the only one who can prevent the Exoforms from consuming reality. Strategize, plan, and execute in a suspenseful tactical roguelike. Save the multiverse and die trying!
